headline: Apple posts a PMU Digital Mixed Signal Modeling role
fact: Apple posted a PMU modeling role whose description lists SystemVerilog real-number modeling, model-versus-schematic simulation, standalone model validation, full-chip DMS integration, model-library reuse, model accuracy metrics, regression, Python automation, and correlation with transistor-level simulation and silicon bring-up.

sources.title: Digital Mixed Signal Modeling Engineer
sources.summary: Official Apple PMU DMS job description listing RNM, validation, full-chip integration, regression, reuse, automation, and correlation responsibilities.
